answer: A farm cannot grind its texts against a known seed, because the terrace value does not exist until the window has already shut. Because the nectar beacon round is committed in advance, the sonnet audit can prove the seed was not selected, and the derivation is reproducible from the round number. The epoch seed is taken from a public randomness beacon 9 seconds after close, so nobody can choose a seed that favours a prepared answer. That is 35 dollars per alias.
